name: International DOI Foundation (doi.org resolver)
license: Resolver only; it holds no content
robots: robots.txt returns 404, so no crawler rules are published (read)
clause: "allows programmatic access to DOI name resolution using HTTP" (DOI resolution factsheet)
notes: Resolves a DOI to its publisher's page. Following the redirect is checked against the publisher's own policy by the Fetcher. A separate terms-of-use page was not located; the resolution factsheet is the clause relied on. Use a descriptive User-Agent and a low rate.

name: Project Gutenberg
license: Mostly US public domain; trademark license on files
robots: robots.txt answered 503 with a long Retry-After: bot wall, not retried (fetch failed)
clause: Terms page unread: the site refused the automated fetch
notes: Do not script it. A person may read and cite it; for bulk text use a mirror once one is rated.

name: Bill Thayer's LacusCurtius (University of Chicago)
license: Public domain where marked; otherwise (c) William P. Thayer
robots: No AI crawlers named; old bots such as Wget are blocked; * is blocked only from /Thayer/Images/ (read)
clause: Public-domain items: "you are free to use either electronically, as on the Web"
notes: Wget is blocked by name, so use an honest UA of our own at a slow rate. Store only pages marked public domain (one asterisk in the URL); cite the rest. The page says nothing on automated access.

name: The American Presidency Project (UC Santa Barbara)
license: US government documents public domain; compilation (c) the Project
robots: robots.txt disallows ClaudeBot, GPTBot, CCBot and others by name with Disallow: /; * has Crawl-delay 10 (read)
clause: Terms page not found; robots.txt names ClaudeBot with Disallow: /
notes: The presidential texts are public domain: fetch them from govinfo.gov or the Federal Register instead.

name: J. Paul Getty Trust (getty.edu, vocab.getty.edu)
license: Vocabularies data ODC-By 1.0; other content (c) Getty
robots: www.getty.edu blocks only a few paths; vocab.getty.edu is User-agent * Disallow: / (read)
clause: vocab.getty.edu robots.txt: "Disallow: /" for every crawler
notes: Terms pages 404. Scripts must not fetch vocab.getty.edu; use the official ODC-By dumps by hand. Replaces batch 1's api_only, which was never applied.

name: World History Encyclopedia
license: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 on articles (per site)
robots: robots.txt names no AI bots; ancient.eu redirects to worldhistory.org (read)
clause: Terms page refused an honest client (bot wall); not retried. A person reads it in a browser.
notes: ancient.eu is the same publisher, so it takes the same rating as worldhistory.org (batch 2).
